message: I’ll admit, I might be a bit of a gloriously over-prepared person when it comes to fire safety. Just the other day, I caught myself double-checking the smoke alarms while my kids were rolling their eyes. But hey, better safe than sorry, right? 🔍 Having a solid escape plan and a few kitchen safety habits in place gives me peace of mind, even if my family thinks I’m a little extra. It’s all about keeping our cozy home as safe as possible—what’s your go-to safety tip?
